answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose the SAGCopy summarization model ... We evaluate the model on public text summarization datasets such as CNN/Daily Mail and Gigaword.

answer_2.quote: We adopt ROUGE (RG) F1 score as the evaluation metric. ... Table shows ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, ROUGE-L scores for the models.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluations to measure the quantify of the summaries for importance and readability. We randomly selected 100 samples from the Gigaword test set. The annotators are required to give a comparison between two model summaries that are presented anonymously.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compared two summaries and judged which was better in terms of importance and readability.
